When fd 2 is a tty (docker run -t), use runuser so the tty group required
to open /dev/pts/N survives the privilege drop. When fd 2 is a pipe, wrap
bin/compile, bin/test-compile and bin/test in a FIFO bridge so the
unprivileged user can reopen /dev/stderr -> /proc/self/fd/2, which is
otherwise blocked because the pipe is owned by root.

non-tty runs), removing the need for the env var entirely.

Switch to the simpler combination that the HEROKUISH_WITH_TTY machinery
already on this branch was designed for: pass -t on the test harness's
docker run so fd 2 is a pty, and rely on the existing tty-group + runuser

fix: allocate a pty for buildpack tests via docker run -t

Pairs with HEROKUISH_WITH_TTY=true. Without -t, fd 2 inside the container
